title: German Shaggy's Beef Stew
description: A hearty German-inspired beef stew made with tender shanks and a rich broth, perfect for a cold evening. Serve with a side of warm bread or over egg noodles.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Season the beef shanks with salt and pepper.
Sear the beef shanks until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the beef shanks from the pot and set aside.
Add the sliced onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced carrot and celery to the pot and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the German broth, tomato paste, and beef broth to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the beef shanks to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
